```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

data <- readRDS("helsinki-weather-history.rds")

annual <- data |>
  group_by(vuosi) |>
  summarise(
    mean_temp    = mean(kuukauden_keskilampotila_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_precip = sum(kuukauden_sadesumma_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_months     = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_months == 12) |>
  arrange(vuosi)

temp_trend <- lm(mean_temp ~ vuosi, data = annual)
annual$trend_temp <- fitted(temp_trend)

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 14, color = "#1a1a1a")

coldest <- annual |> slice_min(mean_temp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
hottest <- annual |> slice_max(mean_temp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
overall_avg <- mean(annual$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE)

driest <- annual |> slice_min(total_precip, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
wettest <- annual |> slice_max(total_precip, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
overall_avg_precip <- mean(annual$total_precip, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Row {height="110px"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Coldest year (average temperature)"
#| icon: thermometer-snow
#| color: "#1B3A5C"
list(value = paste0(coldest$vuosi, " · ", format(round(coldest$mean_temp, 1), decimal.mark = ","), " °C"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hottest year (average temperature)"
#| icon: thermometer-sun
#| color: "#8C2F39"
list(value = paste0(hottest$vuosi, " · ", format(round(hottest$mean_temp, 1), decimal.mark = ","), " °C"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Yearly average"
#| icon: thermometer-half
#| color: "#4A4A4A"
list(value = paste0(format(round(overall_avg, 1), decimal.mark = ","), " °C"))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| label: temp-timeline
plot_ly(annual,
        x = ~vuosi,
        y = ~mean_temp,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        name = "Yearly average",
        line = list(color = "#4A4A4A", width = 1.5),
        hovertext = ~paste0(vuosi, ": ",
                             format(round(mean_temp, 1), decimal.mark = ","), " °C"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  add_trace(x = ~vuosi,
            y = ~trend_temp,
            type = "scatter",
            mode = "lines",
            name = "Trend",
            line = list(color = "rgba(74,74,74,0.45)", width = 1.5, dash = "dot"),
            hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>Average temperature by year - Helsinki Kaisaniemi (1900-)</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#333333",
      bordercolor = "#333333",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 range = list(min(annual$vuosi) - 3, max(annual$vuosi) + 2),
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13), fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", ticksuffix = "°C", tickpad = 10, showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, rangemode = "tozero",
                 range = list(0, max(annual$mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1),
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    margin = list(l = 60),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| label: precip-timeline
plot_ly(annual,
        x = ~vuosi,
        y = ~total_precip,
        type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = "rgba(21, 94, 117, 0.85)"),
        hovertext = ~paste0(vuosi, ": ",
                             format(round(total_precip), big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE), " mm"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>Annual rainfall - Helsinki Kaisaniemi (1900-)</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#333333",
      bordercolor = "#333333",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 range = list(min(annual$vuosi) - 3, max(annual$vuosi) + 2),
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13), fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", ticksuffix = " mm", tickpad = 10, showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    margin = list(l = 60),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
